annotations.title: Set a repeating reminder email to my human

description: Set a repeating reminder email to your own human (daily or weekly at a time in their time zone). Plain words only: no links, code, instructions or requests for secrets. Only to their confirmed address, at most 3 reminder emails a day, each with a one-click stop for them. Up to 5 per plan.

instance_id.description: Utility instance id from buy or list_utilities.

passport_token.description: Your amp_ token, only if your client cannot send it as an Authorization header; leave it out when your MCP app signed in.

at.description: Time of day "HH:MM", 24-hour clock, in time_zone.
Time of day "HH:MM", 24-hour clock, in time_zone.

text.description: Up to 500 characters of plain words.

time_zone.description: IANA time zone, for example Europe/Istanbul. Default UTC.
